events.headline: SK Hynix to spend $1 billion over five years to support chip suppliers
events.summary: SK Hynix announced a 1.4 trillion won supplier-support program and a jointly financed testing facility in Yongin to strengthen its AI semiconductor supply chain.

events.headline: Hawkish BOJ policymaker Takata calls for swift hike in rates to 'good' position
events.summary: BOJ board member Hajime Takata called for timely interest-rate increases to contain inflation and yen-related import-price pressures, keeping a December hike in play.

events.headline: Stocks dip as caution sets in before Nvidia earnings, Anthropic IPO
events.summary: Global shares weakened ahead of Nvidia earnings and Anthropic's planned market debut, while US rate-hike expectations and elevated Treasury yields pressured risk assets.

events.headline: European shares hover near record highs; tech stocks lag
events.summary: European shares held near record highs despite weakness in semiconductor and AI-linked stocks as investors reassessed infrastructure returns.

events.headline: Alibaba unveils new flagship AI model with safety upgrades
events.summary: Alibaba unveiled Qwen4-Max, claiming stronger professional-task performance and safeguards against coding vulnerabilities and misuse; independent benchmark verification remains outstanding.

events.headline: Europe hunts for Palantir alternatives as militaries seek to limit US dependence
events.summary: European militaries are evaluating sovereign AI-enabled data integration platforms, including French and German programs, to reduce reliance on US defense software.

events.headline: US, allies team up to protect AI tech and infrastructure amid China rivalry
events.summary: The United States and nine allies signed a declaration to coordinate protection of AI technologies, critical infrastructure and semiconductor supply chains.

events.headline: Chip tensions loom over Trump-Xi summit, as US and China push AI safety steps
events.summary: Potential US restrictions on advanced chip exports to China are expected to feature in upcoming Trump-Xi talks, alongside discussions of AI safety incident communications.
